annotations.text: Corpus, not a demo: every event below is read from this repository's own history — 625 commits and 69 pull requests — via the evidence bundle committed beside this note (docs/corpus/). No row was hand-typed, and the axis states are the repository's own statements or an explicit inference.
The history carries three git identities for its single contributor; all three are attributed here to one person record. The evidence bundle records them as opaque keys, never as names.

Re-opens only on evidence — a real campaign failed, produced ambiguous evidence, or a downstream analysis cannot establish an essential acquisition condition — never because another abstraction looks improvable (docs/agenda.md).
Open inside this closed phase: durable provenance for a refused invocation's write — design direction accepted, nothing implemented (PR #40, merge 426dd5a).
The mixer-enabled first pass stored zero profiles — the rig produced no signal. Written down in the data README so a later reader does not mistake it for a file defect.
SA3/POD and SA6 UI remain demand-driven; #49 remains open and separate (docs/agenda.md).
This axis's state is inferred: the repository records the work but nowhere states a status for it, so `active` comes from the commit record rather than from a document.
